svg.title: 02 / From connection signals to a relevant invitation
svg.text: 02 / From connection signals to a relevant invitation
The app uses evidence from the shared graph, checks one missing constraint, then lets both parties choose.
Was your conversation with Theo useful?
What should your next introduction help with?
Alex reports a useful meeting and explicitly refines the need to refillable formats. No transcript.
Alex may be a fit for your offer.
Order size has not been confirmed.
Status: clarification pending. No invitation has been sent.
Maya’s useful booth visit helps surface the candidate. Only appropriate profile/goal details are shown.
One detail before we suggest a visit.
A relevant refillable-packaging supplier starts at 500 units.
Would that work for the project you’re exploring?
A decisive constraint is now confirmed. “No” filters this offer; “not sure” stays unresolved.
Why this fits: skincare brand + refillable interest + compatible order size.
Compare refillable samples with our specialist. 15 minutes at Booth 24; formats start at
Exhibitor authorizes a specific invitation. Private connection histories and meetup ratings stay internal.
Compare refillable samples and discuss fit with a packaging specialist.
Why this fits: you’re exploring refillable skincare packaging, and a 500-unit minimum works for you.
Accepted invitation + reserved slot. “Not now” is a timing response; acceptance is not attendance.
The offer now has an accepted booking. The graph has no completed-visit evidence yet.
Did you find what you needed?
Would you like to share a next step with RefillWorks?
Visit + private usefulness + an explicitly shared next-step request. No sale is inferred.
A useful next step to follow up.
1 invitation sent → 1 accepted → 1 visit checked in
The request is visible to your team. A quote has not been sent.
Track accepted visits and shared follow-ups. A person’s private feedback is not an exhibitor rating feed.
DISCUSSION SKETCH · fictional example · successive states may be grouped · no working UI
